# JSTNURMIND

> JSTNURMIND (pronounced "Just In Your Mind") is a masked producer and DJ, originally from New York City and based in Austin, Texas. His music moves between alternative hip-hop, house, techno, and other corners of underground electronic music.

Official website: https://jstnurmind.com

- [Discography](https://jstnurmind.com/music/)
- [Live & radio archive](https://jstnurmind.com/live/)
- [Contact](https://jstnurmind.com/#contact)
